tier_reason: Full independent client, near-1:1 parity with javascript on auth+chat.
last_verified_by: workforce and social-inbox wrappers diffed against the Erghi controller source and request models, plus per-SDK wire tests

auth.evidence: python/erghi/resources/auth.py:17-89 -- 2026-10-12: auth now targets the real GoTrue routes behind /api/auth/* (/token, /user, /recover, /verify) and maps its snake_case session; earlier refresh/me/password-reset paths did not exist on the platform.

chat.evidence: python/erghi/resources/chat.py:18-121 -- full parity with javascript's chat.ts.

widgets.note: No widget resource file at all -- javascript at least has createWidget; python has none. Real gap.

inbox.note: Workspace surface (member access token), never the visitor surface. Workspace API keys cannot hold view_conversations/manage_inbox_settings/manage_contacts (not grantable), so they get 403. Contacts, notifications, @mentions and unassign require platform PR #256 (not merged when this was written).

reply_engine.note: Unreleased; written against the platform reply-engine worktree (API version 2026-11-22), not yet verified against a deployed platform. No live hub client (REST + webhook only).

workforce.note: Workspace surface. manage_workforce is a grantable API-key permission (status force, sign-out, away reasons, skills, profiles, settings); own status, offers and routing-decision need view_conversations, which a key can never hold, so they need a member token. Reports need view_insights and a plan with workforce analytics. Live board and report bodies are loosely typed (the server builds them ad hoc). PUT profile is not partial. Requires the platform release that adds the Workforce API (not merged when this was written).

social_inbox.note: Workspace surface. moderate_social is a grantable API-key permission (hide, reply, private reply, done, ignore); connections and settings need configure_ai, the report needs view_insights. The social inbox ships dark (403 social_inbox_unavailable). The Meta OAuth connect flow is deliberately not wrapped (browser-only). Requires the platform release that adds the social inbox (not merged when this was written).

notes: Auth+chat are the strongest parity story in the whole repo (matches javascript method-for-method). Widget management is the one real gap -- worth a small follow-up PR before calling this SDK fully caught up.
